theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_adic_character_lift
theorems.statement: ∀ {C G : Type} [CommRing C] [Group G] (J : Ideal C) [IsAdicComplete J C] (a : ℕ → G → C), (∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m → ∀ g : G, a m g - a n g ∈ J ^ n) → (∀ n : ℕ, a n 1 - 1 ∈ J ^ n) → (∀ (n : ℕ) (g h : G), a n (g * h) - a n g * a n h ∈ J ^ n) → ∃! b : G →* Cˣ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : G), (b g : C) - a n g ∈ J ^ n
